independence: Reviewer authored none of these three source modules; full source and upstream APIs read independently. Some old C1/vector lexical hits were reviewer-authored, and are compared only by actual type mismatch, not presented as independent semantic review of those old modules.
scientific_conclusion: Actual constant-input native P integral, actual Q Brownian controlled elementary integral and original TerminalGirsanovData use SAME P/Q/density/energy; original p_kl_05 yields exact full KL=u²T/2 and every measurable readout bound.
full_source_semantic_checks: baselineInput is the original fullPredictableL2 interval input with constant coefficient u; original predictableIntegral returns the SAME literal u(B_T−B_0) AE under P, not an assumed symbolic integral.

Controlled elementary integral is literal u(W_t−W_0) under the already proved actual Q Brownian source; its martingale uses original Ft. This does not construct arbitrary full predictable Q integrals.

Original TerminalGirsanovData is constructed field by field, including actual constant progressive real-time control, Fin2 [0,T] filtration clock, actual terminal martingale, literal initial0, energy u²T, and actual exp density. No desired shifted-law/integral/energy/martingale field is taken as a caller premise.

ChangeOfMeasure is SAME old tiltedLaw withDensity definition. Actual RN equals SAME expProcess under Q through original data theorem; actual consumer checks density/changeOfMeasure identities. AE density exponent uses actual B0=0, while integral shift retains B0 on both sides pointwise.
Original fullSpaceKL_eq_halfEnergy and original p_kl_05 are directly called. Measurable observation/readout KL is bounded by full KL; equality for every coarse readout is not claimed.

Clock is F_(toNNReal t) for control and original F0/FT for the terminal data; no OU-clock confusion, no enlargement, no substituted Q. Beyond T the W drift is clipped, so no claim of constant drift forever.
actual_public_consumer_obligations: u=2,T=1: energy4, exact full KL2, original p_kl_05 observed B1 bound2
ALL measurable raw B-path readout consumer; SAME Q-RN/density/changeOfMeasure/controlled clock bindings
scope_and_remaining_obligations: Constant scalar control on fixed finite horizon only; not general predictable-control Girsanov/SDE.
Full-space KL equality; arbitrary readout only data-processing inequality.
Original arbitrary-control consumer now has a real nontrivial constant-source inhabitant, not proof of its hypotheses for all controls.

all_source_rows.header_preview: theorem baseline_returns_actual_integral (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     (predictableIntegral T (baselineInput u T) : (ℝ≥0 → ℝ) → ℝ) =ᵐ[sourceLaw] baselineIntegral u T := by   rw [baselineInput,integral_interval_literal]   exact (oneStep_memLp_two (memLp_top_const u) 0 T).coeFn_toLp

theorem controlledIntegralProcess_martingale (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     Martingale (controlledIntegralProcess u T) naturalFiltration (tiltedLaw u T) := by   have hconst := martingale_const_fun naturalFiltration (tiltedLaw u T)     (shiftedProcess_stronglyAdapted u T 0) ((shiftedProcess_isPreBrownian u T).integrable_eval 0)   exact ((shiftedProcess_martingale u T).sub hconst).smul u

theorem terminalClock_mono (T : ℝ≥0) : Monotone (terminalClock T) := by   intro i j hij   fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [terminalClock]  def terminalFiltration (T : ℝ≥0) : Filtration (Fin 2) (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ℝ≥0 → ℝ)) where   seq i := naturalFiltration (terminalClock T i)

theorem terminalIntegral_martingale (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     Martingale (fun i => controlledIntegralProcess u T (terminalClock T i)) (terminalFiltration T) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   have hm := controlledIntegralProcess_martingale u T   exact ⟨fun i => hm.stronglyAdapted (terminalClock T i),fun i j hij => hm.condExp_ae_eq (terminalClock_mono T hij)⟩

theorem constantControl_energy (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) :     controlEnergy T (constantControl u) ω=u^2*(T : ℝ) := by   simp only [controlEnergy,constantControl,intervalIntegral.integral_const,sub_zero,smul_eq_mul,     Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]   ring

theorem actual_integral_shift (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) :     baselineIntegral u T ω=controlledIntegralProcess u T T ω+controlEnergy T (constantControl u) ω := by   rw [constantControl_energy]   unfold baselineIntegral oneStep increment controlledIntegralProcess shiftedProcess   simp only [Pi.mul_apply,min_self,zero_min,NNReal.coe_zero,mul_zero,sub_zero]   ring

theorem actual_fullSpaceKL (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     klDiv (tiltedLaw u T) sourceLaw = ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2 : ℝ)*u^2*(T : ℝ)) := by   rw [(actualTerminalData u T).fullSpaceKL_eq_halfEnergy]   have he : controlEnergy T (constantControl u) = fun _ => u^2*(T : ℝ) := funext (constantControl_energy u T)   rw [he,integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul]   congr 1

theorem actual_observedPathKL {Γ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Γ] (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0)     (readout : (ℝ≥0 → ℝ) → Γ) (hreadout : Measurable readout) :     klDiv ((tiltedLaw u T).map readout) (sourceLaw.map readout) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2 : ℝ)*u^2*(T : ℝ)) := by   rw [← actual_fullSpaceKL u T]   exact klDiv_map_le (tiltedLaw u T) sourceLaw hreadout

theorem actual_p_kl_05 {Γ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Γ] (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0)     (readout : (ℝ≥0 → ℝ) → Γ) (hreadout : Measurable readout) :     klDiv (tiltedLaw u T) sourceLaw = ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2 : ℝ)*u^2*(T : ℝ)) ∧     klDiv ((tiltedLaw u T).map readout) (sourceLaw.map readout) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2 : ℝ)*u^2*(T : ℝ)) := by   have h := (actualTerminalData u T).p_kl_05 readout hreadout   have he : controlEnergy T (constantControl u) = fun _ => u^2*(T : ℝ) := funext (constantControl_energy u T)
